comments: There are no specific comments on the publication. Cepheid moduli are compiled and homogenized from earlier HST Key Project and independent studies. Previous author included it.
The random error is enlarged by the modest Cepheid sample and propagation of the reddening estimate. The modulus assumes mu_LMC=18.50 mag and excludes the common zero-point systematic.
Final period-cut Wesenheit fit before abundance correction. e_R is the random PL-fit error only; N_cef is the post-cut sample.
Preferred near-solar-metallicity solution and nearly insensitive to Vlim (-0.01/-0.04 mag). Table 6 gives 53 sosie matches, not a verified number of unique Cepheids.
Present-paper HIPPARCOS-calibrated PL solution. The internal uncertainty excludes the separately evaluated calibration and PL-slope terms.
Maximum-light LMC PL solution. It is nearly identical to the corresponding mean-light result.
Representative mean-light OGLE LMC solution. CTE corrected but not metallicity corrected.
Representative FSG03 Galactic mean-light solution. CTE corrected and uncorrected for metallicity.
